login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your Brooch workspace
login.selectionRestart: Please sign in again to choose a company.
login.intentBanner: You are signing in to open another Brooch application.

register.title: Register company
register.subtitle: Create your company — no password yet
register.companyHint: Company names are optional — add Arabic, English, or both.
register.emailInvalid: Enter a valid owner email address.
register.successNew: We sent a set-password link to your email. Open it to activate your account.
register.successExisting: This email is already registered. Sign in with your existing password.
register.stepMailbox: Check your email for the set-password link.
register.stepSetPassword: Open the link and choose a secure password.
register.stepSignIn: Return here and sign in with your new password.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.subtitle: Activate your account by choosing a secure password.
setPassword.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters with a mix of letters and numbers.
setPassword.success: Your password is set. Sign in to access your Brooch workspace.
setPassword.invalidLink: This activation link is not valid. Open the set-password link from your email.
setPassword.stepMailbox: Check your email for the activation link.
setPassword.stepOpenLink: Open the set-password link from that email.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link if an account exists.
forgot.privacyNote: For security, we show the same confirmation whether or not the email is registered.
forgot.success: If an account exists for this address, a password reset link has been sent.
forgot.stepMailbox: Check your email for the password reset link.
forgot.stepResetLink: Open the link and choose a new password.
forgot.stepSignIn: Sign in with your new password when finished.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Create a strong password for your Brooch account.
reset.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters with a mix of letters and numbers.
reset.success: Your password has been updated. Sign in with your new credentials.
reset.invalidLink: This reset link is not valid or has already been used. Request a fresh link.

selectCompany.title: Select company
selectCompany.subtitle: Choose which company to continue with
selectCompany.chooseHint: Pick the workspace you want to open.
selectCompany.intentBanner: After selection you will continue to the requested Brooch application.
selectCompany.emptyList: No companies are available for selection. Sign in again or contact your administrator.

denied.title: Access denied
denied.body: You do not have permission to open this resource with your current role in this company.
denied.hint: If you believe this is a mistake, contact your workspace administrator or review your assigned access.

accessDenied.title: Application access denied
accessDenied.body: Your account does not have permission to open the requested Brooch application.
accessDenied.hint: Try signing in with a different account or company, or contact your workspace administrator.

layout.heroTitle: One secure sign-in for your entire Brooch workspace
layout.heroLead: Manage companies, teams, and access to every Brooch application from a single hub.
layout.featureApps: Launch CRM and sibling apps instantly

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.body: Your session has ended for security. Sign in again to continue where you left off.
sessionExpired.returnHint: After signing in, you will return to the page you were viewing.

applications.title: Applications
applications.subtitle: Open Brooch apps you are eligible for in this company. Your session stays signed in across apps.
applications.justOnboarded: Company activated. Welcome to your workspace.
applications.emptyBody: You do not have access to any Brooch applications in this company. Contact your administrator if you need access.
applications.ssoHint: Opening an app uses your existing Brooch session — you will not need to sign in again.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: View and invite people in this company. Invites send a set-password email for new users.
members.inviteHint: New users receive a set-password email. Existing Brooch users are linked to this company.
members.rolesHint: Select at least one role for the invite.
members.rolesEmpty: No roles available for this company.
members.teamsHint: Optional — assign one or more teams with the invite.
members.teamsEmpty: No teams available for this company.
members.empty: No members yet — invite someone to get started.
members.invitedSetPassword: Invite sent — the user will receive a set-password email.
members.invitedExisting: Existing user linked to this company.
members.editRolesLead: Choose roles for {{name}}. At least one role is required.
members.editRolesHint: Selected roles replace the member’s current set.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Read-only view of roles and bundled permissions in this company, grouped by application.
roles.readOnlyHint: Role editing is not available in Account v1. Contact your administrator to change access.
roles.emptyBody: This company has no roles configured. They will appear here once provisioned.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Reference catalog of permission keys available across Brooch applications, grouped by app and feature area.
permissions.catalogHint: This catalog is read-only. Permissions are assigned through roles in each application.
permissions.emptyBody: The permission catalog is empty. Entries will appear here once configured.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Browse your company team hierarchy and nested sub-teams.
teams.structureHint: Assign a manager to each team from its members. Nested sub-teams appear under their parent.
teams.emptyBody: This company has no teams configured. They will appear here once your organization structure is set up.
teams.assignManagerLead: Choose a manager for {{team}} from the team's members.
teams.assignManagerEmpty: This team has no members to assign as manager.

myAccess.title: My access
myAccess.subtitle: Roles and effective permissions assigned to you in the current company.
myAccess.rolesLead: Roles determine which permission bundles apply to your account.
myAccess.permissionsLead: Union of all permissions granted by your roles, grouped by application.
myAccess.accessHint: This view reflects your access in the selected company only. Switch company to review access elsewhere.
myAccess.noRoles: You have no roles assigned in this company.
myAccess.noPermissions: You have no permissions in this company.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Manage your profile, switch companies, and control active sessions.
account.profileLead: Your Brooch account details for this signed-in user.
account.name: Display name
account.companiesLead: Memberships you can access. Switch company to change workspace context.
account.noCompanies: You are not linked to any companies.
account.sessionsLead: Active sign-in sessions for your account on this device and others.

onboarding.title: Set up your workspace
onboarding.subtitle: Finish company details and choose a package to start your free trial.
onboarding.companyHint: These names appear across Brooch apps and on invoices.
onboarding.packageHint: Pick the plan that fits your team. You can change it later.
onboarding.startTrialHint: No payment required — your trial starts immediately after sign-in.
onboarding.noPackages: No packages are available right now. Contact support or try again later.
